summary.headline: Scorpio and Pisces Omens
summary.text: Astrological predictions for Saturn and Jupiter when elevated in Scorpio and Pisces, including rain, famine, warfare, political upheaval, deaths of rulers, floods, and the condition of agriculture, animals, cities, and ships. The passage also begins discussing the conjunction of Mars and Saturn in the triplicities.
